work_order: In memory_system/store.py, add ('patient', 'confidential', 'self') to DEFAULT_ROLE_GRANTS so newly created stores automatically grant patients access to their own confidential records.

Modify MemoryStore.retrieve() to handle existing stores that lack the patient-confidential grant: when the role_grants join produces NULL for requires_rel and requester_role == 'patient' and requester_id == patient_id and record sensitivity == 'confidential', treat the effective requires_rel as 'self' and proceed to the relationship/scope gate with that value. This preserves backward compatibility without altering existing authorization data.
